title: search degraded-zero retry suppression contract

changes.summary: Added a separate in-process degraded-zero suppression map with TTL, without storing degraded zero results in the normal search cache.
Added degraded_zero_suppressed_total so suppressed degraded-zero outcomes stay visible and are not counted as cache hits.
Exposed suppressed degraded-zero counts in search aggregation summaries.
Added unit contracts for suppression hit, TTL disable, and separate stats accounting.

notes: Suppression hit avoids repeated upstream MCP search for the same degraded-zero query inside the TTL.
Suppressed outcomes remain degraded-zero for gate interpretation and are not search success evidence.
No large run, full375, bounded completed-source run, or same 38-row parent packet replay was dispatched.
